debate.key_bull_argument: MACD bullish crossover, RSI14 bullish, and supertrend bullish with extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and congressional buying create contrarian entry opportunity near support (26.38).
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 373.28, imminent CPI, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), price below all key moving averages (EMA21/SMA21/EMA50/EMA200 death cross), ichimoku below cloud, zero fundamental conviction, and no triggered strategies make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup in severely adverse conditions.
